note: Defect register for the KYC plan. A defect appears in a session report when at least one of its test cases is Failed or Blocked in that run; 'design' defects (Figma file itself) are always listed. Add the ticket id in 'ticket' once filed. Baseline: first run of 14 Oct 2026 on testbox.

defects.title: "Review request" opens /kyc/requests/<id>/process, which answers HTTP 500 ("Oops! An unexpected error occurred.") for every pending request: no KYC request can be reviewed, approved or rejected
Account list and Manual verification are not implemented: the Kyc & Comp. sidebar group only has "KYC Requests" (Figma: Requests + Account list with "Manual verification")
Request preview of a Confirmed or Rejected request is empty (only the title and ×): agents cannot see what was approved or why a request was rejected

Request preview shows "Invalid date" for ID Reference / ID issue date / ID expired date on some requests, an empty Gender, and the KYC status as lowercase "pending" instead of the Unverified / Required only badge
Pending tab has Reviewed By / Reviewed Date columns but no Requested by, and no "View request" action (the whole row opens the preview)
Filter panel only has a Username field: no Submission type, Country or date-range filters
Pending requests are not ordered by Requested date (queue order unclear: 06/08/2025, 30/09/2026, 30/09/2026, 10/09/2025 …)
Copy/format differs from Figma: heading "KYC Requests" and subtitle "View the list of KYC requests", search placeholder "Search KYC requests...", DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm dates, 20 rows per page (Figma 8)
Search with no result shows the counter "Showing 1 to 0 of 0 results"
A resubmission's preview has no "Submission of <date>" history: earlier submissions and their status are not listed (only the last reviewer and rejection messages)

Figma copy defects: "Personal informations", "Date of of birth", "National identity recipe", "All verified account", Localization plan step reusing "Upload ID document / front side / back side", selfie step titled "ID Card checking details" in one frame; build labels the IUN document "UIN"
